title: Add StoryCraft AI to writing
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [StoryCraft AI](https://khushalkks.github.io/pollinations) to writing
- StoryCraft AI is an interactive digital storybook and scene illustrator powered directly by Pollinations.ai Text and Image Generation APIs. It uses text.pollinations.ai to generate multi-chapter narra

Fixes #14655

gist.headline: A Book Sprouts Wings
gist.blurb: StoryCraft AI has landed in the writing garden: an interactive storybook that grows chapters and illustrated scenes from a prompt. Bring an idea; the little library does the rest of the buzzing.
gist.summary: Added StoryCraft AI to the writing app collection, an interactive digital storybook that uses text.pollinations.ai for multi-chapter narratives and Pollinations image generation for scene illustrations.
gist.impact: Users can now open StoryCraft AI to turn an idea into a multi-chapter illustrated story directly with Pollinations Text and Image APIs.
gist.visual_concept: Depict StoryCraft AI as a cozy magical digital storybook: its open pages contain a growing multi-chapter tale and tiny illustrated landscapes. Polli, wearing a writer's beret and holding a quill, helps story-vines emerge from the pages while a friendly CRT monitor robot presents a newly generated scene; flowers and code-plants connect the book to the Pollinations APIs.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of an open magical digital storybook on a warm cream desk, with illustrated chapter pages blooming into tiny pastel forests and castles while code-plants sprout around it; the main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings, wearing a tiny writer's beret and using a quill to add a chapter as a chunky CRT-monitor robot holds up a freshly illustrated scene. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, dark purple (#110518) outlines, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, subtle pixel-font text: "STORYCRAFT", nostalgic but beautiful and emotionally warm.
